goal: Prevent validation boolean returns from diverging from recorded validation state
Avoid unintended state suppression and ambiguity across block validation call chains
reviewability: Review logic now; rebase is needed due to conflicts with master but is mechanical
agreement: Broad concept support for replacing out-parameters with state return values
Contested objection: asserts and comments risk unexpected runtime aborts over type enforcement (hodlinator)
Verified error reasons remain logged by corrupting a block and forcing a reorg (arejula27)
Concept approval without stated reasons (stringintech, yuvicc, nervana21, w0xlt)

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because it removes the risk of divergent status returns in block validation
Cleans up ambiguity in validation interfaces without introducing consensus or behavioral changes
Benefit is internal code hygiene and is reasonably deferrable
